title: A/R Detail shows its five buckets in fixed order with counts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Read the bucket rows top to bottom.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 3:

  • "91 or more days past due", "61-90 days past due", "31-60 days past due", "1-30 days past due", "Current", each with its number of lines in brackets.

Why this matters: Shops read aging from oldest to newest.
